== Description ==
Purple Reflections II expansion mark with its printed black rim.

== Source ==
Cropped from the scan of Decipher's [[Artoo & •Threepio]], [[:File:Ref2-L-artoo&threepio-hires.webp|file description]] and [[Media:Ref2-L-artoo&threepio-hires.webp|original scan]], credited to [[Strangewayes]] and the HiRez scanning project. The mark is at the right of the lore box. The crop retains the printed colors and masks the surrounding card scan to transparency.
